slides.title: Tigray: a new caretaker administration
slides.body: PM Abiy named a six-month interim government on Oct. 16 (AFP). The TPLF called it illegitimate (Anadolu).

slides.title: Medical supplies sent by WHO
slides.body: Hospitals in Mekelle and Shire resumed services, OCHA said, but fuel and funding gaps remain.

slides.title: Gambella: deadly clashes, curfew
slides.body: Residents told Borkena at least 25 were killed and 80+ injured. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Russia offers to host talks
slides.body: Moscow offered to host Ethiopia-Eritrea talks at an Oct. 28-29 summit. Neither side has replied (Borkena, BBC Amharic).

slides.title: Protect civilians. Choose dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Sources: AFP/Al Jazeera, Anadolu, OCHA via The Reporter, Borkena · Oct 16-17, 2026
